prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: I need to change a flight ASAP but the wait time for speaking to a representative is at least an hour!
Delta: Hi, Candie.  Please DM your confirmation # and contact # so I may call you to discuss. Thanks! *TJF https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: The change to your flight schedules page has made it unprintable - I relied heavily on printable schedules for my VP.
Delta: Hello, Kenny. Sorry to hear. We will look into this. We appreciate your feedback.  *ARD

Customer: your flight cancellation and change service is broken on the site, and your hold time is 2 hours. I need to cancel a flight ASAP.
Delta: Hi, Misty! If you can please DM us here, I'd be happy to further assist. 😃 *TJN https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: any chance I can get someone on the phone in sooner than 2 hours (the current wait time)? Need to change a reservation ASAP.
Delta: How may I help Kenny? *TMS

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: rebooking_change):
"""I can’t make my flight due to a car accident! I need to change my flight ASAP! I cannot miss my cruise tomorrow 😫"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Hi! Please DM us your confirmation # and contact # so we can help rebook you quickly. 🙏
